prompt: Phone app screen, portrait, for a model catalogue. Structure top to bottom, with the biggest region named first. 1. A slim header strip across the top, 7% of the height: the app name 'V\u2019s MultiGen AI Chat' in bold dark type at the left, a small speech-bubble icon with an orange spark at the right, and a thin brass-coloured rule under the strip. 2. Below it, two rows of cream file-folder tabs standing on their edges like index dividers, each tab printed with a facet name and its count: row one 'All 366', 'Language 96', 'Image 41', 'Video 134', 'Voice/TTS 104', 'Music 30', 'Text 88' with 'All' clearly selected (darker, taller, first); row two three wider tabs for the policy facets, each showing its axis name and current value: 'Likeness - Allowed (24)', 'NSFW - Allowed (20)', 'Native voice - Yes (104)'. 3. A search field, full width and clearly an input: cream field, thin dark border, a magnifier glyph at the left, placeholder 'Search 366 models'. 4. THE MAIN ELEMENT, 55% of the screen: one cream index card pulled forward and tilted about four degrees, brighter than the rest, with a soft offset shadow behind it. On it: 'Claude Opus 5.5' in big bold dark type, a small typed id line 'ID: CL-OP55-REV4', then four ruled attribute rows with the label at the left and the value right-aligned in a typed face ('Kind  Text', 'Context  200k', 'Licence  OpenRAIL-M', 'Rating  9.1'); at the card's foot two rubber-stamp marks tilted in opposite directions, a red one reading 'LIMITED' and a blue one reading 'LIKENESS OK'. 5. At the bottom, a full-width filled button in brass-amber reading 'Take this model to the chat' in dark type, and above it a thin centred line 'Showing 66 of 366'. This is a FLAT UI SCREEN DESIGN, drawn as vector shapes, filling the whole canvas edge to edge. No wooden bezel, no picture frame, no device mockup, no surrounding room, no background photograph, no skeuomorphic furniture, no 3D, no shadows cast by objects, no glow, no glass. The pale cream card stock is a UI surface, not a photograph of paper. Every label is a UI label and every control is a real control with a visible state. Real content: model names 'Claude Opus 5.5', 'GPT-6 Luna', 'Aion 3.5 Mini', 'Grok 4.7', 'ElevenLabs Music v2'; facet tabs 'All 366', 'Language 96', 'Image 41', 'Video 134', 'Voice/TTS 104', 'Music 30', 'Text 88'; policy switches 'Likeness Allowed (24)', 'NSFW Allowed (20)', 'Native voice Yes (104)'.
